patch.value: The Curator stands at the lectern, by the way to the Long Hall.
馆长站在讲台旁，就在去长厅的路边。
The Curator stands at the lectern, by the way to the Long Hall.

why: The first objective's hint rewritten to name the Long Hall, with the zh-cn row following. The party reads that hint before anything has said what the Long Hall is — the Curator says it later, in her catalogue line. A hint is the party's instruction, and it names only what the party has been told. Refused naming the objective.
